Mār-diyo contains a give light verb and is not assigned as a simple inherited stem. Reviewed comparison: mewati_akera mārā “don't kill!, he killed” (f_fxsrva6ikkpqe). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.
